advisoryExceptions.reason: esbuild 0.18.20 comes only through drizzle-kit 0.31.11 -> @esbuild-kit/core-utils, a dev-only migration generator. The advisory is about esbuild's dev server (`serve`), which drizzle-kit never starts. Remove when drizzle-kit drops @esbuild-kit.

deepmerge 4.3.1 comes only through @react-email/render -> html-to-text, which merges its own formatter options with ours when packages/email turns a rendered template into plain text (render.tsx: toPlainText(html, { selectors: TEXT_SELECTORS })). Both inputs are constants in this repository; no user-supplied object is ever merged, so prototype poisoning cannot be triggered. No fixed deepmerge release exists yet (4.3.1 is the latest and affected); upgrade or override when one ships.
